action.content: Write a funny poem for kids about a product that you would like to sell. The poem should have exactly 6 stanzas. Separated the stanzas using 3 asterisk markers: ***
action.label: context

action.content:
I have a hat that bounces high,
It reaches up to touch the sky!
It's made of foam and springs of gold,
The bounciest hat that ever was sold.
Put it on your head with care,
And watch it float right through the air!

***

It doesn't stay upon your head,
It zooms around like birds instead.
It does a flip, it does a spin,
It makes your hair all messy, thin.
You try to catch it, but it slips,
And lands right on your neighbor's hips!

***

It has a button, red and bright,
That makes it sing a silly night.
It hums a tune about a cat,
Who lost his socks and ate a hat.
The melody is loud and strange,
It makes the whole neighborhood change!

***

If you are sad, just wear this cap,
It makes you do a happy tap.
It tickles toes and wiggles nose,
It makes you laugh and lose your pose.
No frown can stay upon your face,
When bouncing hats are in the race!

***

But be prepared for one small thing,
It might just make your dinner ring.
It bounces off the dinner plate,
And turns your soup into a date.
It jumps in bowls of mashed potato,
And makes a very funny potato!

***

So buy this hat before it's gone,
The bounciest one since the dawn!
It costs a dime and two old coins,
And brings you joy and silly joins.
Don't wait a second, don't delay,
Or it will bounce and run away!
